menu.hint: Re-apply the modern conspiracy-horror preset: house-rule wounds, SAN, ammo tracking, TL8, agent NPC template.

dialog.title: Apply the Modern Agent preset?
dialog.intro: This sets up the world for a present-day agency campaign:
dialog.mook: The NPC generator's example becomes a field agent
dialog.outro: You can change any of these later in Configure Settings, or re-run this from the Campaign preset button.

change.noCI: Turn off Conditional Injury (replaced by the house wound rules)
change.sanity: Turn on SAN, Breaking Points and Bonds
change.sanRoll: SAN checks use the Fright Check roll
change.ammoEmpty: Block attacks with an empty weapon
change.rapidFire: Rapid fire uses Progressive Recoil (a roll per shot)
change.carryover: Single shots carry half their Acc into the next turn
change.defense: Targets get Dodge / Parry / Block buttons when attacked
change.autoDamage: Failed defenses lead to one-click damage
change.maneuverPrompt: Each combatant picks a maneuver at turn start
change.suppression: NPCs under fire roll Will-2 or stay pinned behind cover
